{"code": "import pandas as pd

# Load the data
sales_df = pd.read_csv('/home/musel/Github/research_agent/data/sales.csv')

# Filter for NEW customers reached by PAID SEARCH
filtered_df = sales_df[(sales_df['customer_segment'] == 'new') & (sales_df['channel'] == 'paid_search')]

# Calculate the fraction who converted
num_converted = filtered_df['converted'].sum()
total_new_paid_search = len(filtered_df)
fraction_converted = num_converted / total_new_paid_search

print(f'Number of NEW customers reached by PAID SEARCH: {total_new_paid_search}')
print(f'Number who converted: {num_converted}')
print(f'Fraction converted: {fraction_converted}')

# Return the fraction
fraction_converted"}
